page.notes: The mark before "711" in the row for XVIII is an unclear symbol, read as a b-like flourish; it is not certain. The small "c" in the left margin beside the row "2" is a printed mark, not transcribed as text. The leader dashes between the year columns and the Feriæ numbers are omitted. The right edge of the Feriæ column is cut off by the scan; the numbers shown are as far as legible. The entries "Sept." are printed with a day number before them; the spacing in the scan is irregular.
